question: After changing only the active MuJoCo application-receipt serialization seam, does the unchanged portable recovery policy complete and retain its first genuine active command application on outer step thirteen while the paired matched-zero arm remains unactuated?

controlled_change.changed_surface: Convert the NumPy comparison result used by ordered_host_clamped to a built-in bool, factor the exact model-free active target mapping and application receipt construction/canonicalization into production helpers, and invoke those helpers from both the native route and the zero-world qualification.

threshold_and_margin_authority.entry_prone_confirm_steps_provenance: The immutable R24D17 profile and production portable core require twelve consecutive entry-prone observations. R24D26 neither chooses nor tunes this value.
threshold_and_margin_authority.active_application_threshold: At least one finite non-zero target velocity and at least one finite non-zero applied native impulse among the exact eight ordered actuators.
threshold_and_margin_authority.active_application_threshold_provenance: This is the unchanged R24D25 identity test for active native application, not a behavioral performance threshold.
threshold_and_margin_authority.adequacy_argument: The predecessor failed before a complete application receipt or behavior evaluation existed. Standard JSON leaf types, exact canonicalization, phase/order/cardinality, and the unchanged zero-versus-non-zero application predicates are sufficient for this distinct integration successor without adding a behavioral threshold or margin.

selected_development_cell.selection_provenance: This is the exact deterministic, outcome-exposed R24D24/R24D25 development cell; R24D25 failed at a data-type seam independent of random seed.
selected_development_cell.selection_adequacy: R24D26 changes only serialization and repeats the shortest same-cell route necessary to obtain the previously missing complete receipt. Another seed cannot exercise a different serializer. No population claim is made.

derivation: Post-step observations one through twelve advance the unchanged portable prone confirmation state.
Observation twelve plans the first establish-distal-support command.
Outer index twelve is the first and shortest opportunity to apply and serialize that command.
coverage_manifest: execute the exact previously qualified V2 context and observer route for both paired arms
retain all twelve confirmation observations and the exact phase transition
apply, canonicalize, retain, and measure the first active candidate command
prove the matched-zero arm remains unactuated through the same horizon
retain every native observation, application receipt, portable receipt, and compact decision projection
explicitly_not_covered: controller physical viability beyond the first applied command
ghost_horizon.adequacy: Thirteen steps per arm remains the exact shortest physical horizon. The serialization defect was seed-independent and active-path-specific; a full development demonstration or extra seed is not required before this one decision.

execution_valid_requires: both serial arms construct exactly one genuine MuJoCo model and world
both arms retain exactly thirteen complete observations, native receipts, collector receipts, and portable step receipts
every application receipt is canonicalized and contains only standard JSON scalar types
all inherited context, observer, route, initializer, mapping, intervention, and portable support invariants pass
the paired V2 evaluation accepts the complete traces as a valid physical development trace
the full trace, compact projection, manifest, reservation, and supervisor completion publish append-only
positive_requires: both arms record prone confirmation counts one through twelve
both arms first transition from confirm_prone to establish_distal_support after observation twelve
the candidate has exactly one complete active native application at outer index twelve
the active application retains eight target velocities, eight built-in boolean clamp facts, eight positive force caps, and eight applied impulses
at least one candidate target velocity and one native applied impulse are finite and non-zero
the candidate post-step observation independently reports at least one non-zero applied impulse
the matched-zero arm has no active native application and every observation identifies zero command
both arms retain entry-prone classification through the twelve confirmation samples and respect recovery joint limits on every step
decision_rule.valid_negative: An execution-valid run that fails one or more positive predicates is retained and closed as a development negative. Physics failure remains visible.
decision_rule.invalid_or_incomplete: A source, qualification, schema, route, invariant, publication, operation-lock, serialization, or trace-completeness failure is retained as invalid or incomplete and cannot answer the command-application question.

active_application_serialization_control: the exact production active target mapper emits only built-in booleans and the exact production application receipt canonicalizes
the historical NumPy boolean leaf is rejected by the production receipt helper before physics

the exact contract, production helper, worker, audit, and wrappers are committed and pushed
one official qualification receipt binds that exact clean-pushed source head
local HEAD, upstream main, and live origin/main remain exactly equal and the worktree remains clean
